decision_skill.name: error_validated_damped_trend
decision_skill.description: Use a recent-window linear trend only when backtesting shows lower rolling absolute error than a constant local-level forecast, and damp its slope as the forecast horizon increases.
decision_skill.applicability: Short-horizon time-series forecasting where recent drift may persist temporarily but is unlikely to continue unchanged across the full horizon.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Compare recent-window trend models against a constant local-level baseline using rolling-origin absolute error; select the best validated trend and progressively shrink its slope contribution toward zero with forecast distance.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when no trend window reliably beats the local-level baseline, the estimated slope is unstable across nearby windows, or structural breaks make recent drift unrepresentative.
